claim_boundary: This protocol fixes a full induced-response common-scalar KKT kernel in the frozen atomic independent-particle coefficient space. Its synthetic unit controls prove exact source/dual pairing, support constraints, continuum reciprocity/passivity, stationarity, and envelope identities. They do not bind a physical continuum, stationary permanent density, gas energy, nonpolar functional, coordinate derivative, force/PES, experimental solvation label, total solvation prediction, or chemistry accuracy metric.

construction.continuum_term: 0.5 (v0 + B_R x)^T Q_R (v0 + B_R x), where Q_R is a matching energy-conjugate reciprocal passive surface response and v0 is an explicitly provenance-pending permanent surface potential.
construction.electronic_term: 0.5 x^T C_R^+ x on the exact V0-RK support, where C_R is the frozen positive semidefinite atomic independent-particle response completion.
construction.external_term: x^T f in the frozen transition-density coefficient/dual convention.
construction.name: route2-v0-full-response-kkt-v1
construction.source: B_R maps the exact frozen atomic-HF GTO transition-density coefficients to electronic surface MEP and B_R^T is the only surface-charge-to-coefficient dual.
construction.stationarity: [H_R,N_R^T;N_R,0][x;eta]=-[B_R^T Q_R v0+f;0], with H_R=C_R^+ + B_R^T Q_R B_R and N_R spanning exactly ker(C_R).

decision_rule: A failed structural, physical, force, runtime, or chemistry gate rejects the current frozen physical binding. No failed gate authorizes fitting, retraining, calibration, response damping, eigenvalue clipping, cavity/radius tuning, or a post-hoc correction.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not re-use the rejected one-radial MACE l=1 Gaussian source.
Do not convert MACE-MDP into a density or energy/force model, alter MACE weights, alter atomic-HF transitions, rescale a response, or repair an eigenvalue to pass a gate.
Do not use a synthetic continuum control as a physical continuum, total solvation free energy, force model, or accuracy result.
Do not run a FreeSolv, MNSol, multi-solvent, or other experimental accuracy panel from this structural gate.
physical_binding_required_before_any_acc: A stationary, separately provenance-bound permanent electronic source in the same coefficient/surface dual convention.
A physical smooth-coordinate reciprocal continuum with source/dual, cavity, and coordinate-derivative certificates.
Twelve-record, ten-actual-functional-group QM density/MEP/reaction-potential physics gates that read no experimental solvation label.
Full envelope-force, coordinate-loop, grid/cavity refinement, and runtime gates.
Frozen all-record historical, multi-solvent/custom-solvent, confirmation, and never-used blind experimental protocols.
required_structural_gates: The V0-RK completion exactly matches the frozen atomic-IP coefficient space and N_R spans its response-kernel null space.
The GTO source map and its transpose satisfy q^T B_R x=x^T B_R^Tq without a separately written VJP.
The continuum has matching atomic numbers, geometry, and surface points; it is linear, reciprocal, and passive in the declared full source support.
C_R^+ and H_R are symmetric, and H_R is strictly positive on Ran(C_R).
The returned state recomputes the KKT residual, support residual, surface linearity, half-coupling ledger, reciprocal/passive external response, and both envelope identities.
